story.iWant: E-stop to immediately disable all motors
story.soThat: I can quickly stop all motion in an emergency

tasks.task: Configure GPIO_E_STOP interrupt - falling edge, input with pull-up, register ISR
Implement E-stop ISR - call sr_emergency_disable_all(), set GPIO_SR_OE HIGH, notify task
Extend safety_monitor_task - NOTIFY_ESTOP handling, MODE_ESTOP, mark axes UNHOMED, publish event
Implement mode checking in motion command handlers - reject MOVE/MOVR/VEL/HOME in ESTOP mode
Implement RST command handler - check button released, clear ESTOP, transition to IDLE
Add error codes: ERR_EMERGENCY_STOP, ERR_ESTOP_ACTIVE, MSG_EMERGENCY_STOP, MSG_ESTOP_ACTIVE
E-stop release detection - poll GPIO state in RST handler
Unit tests for E-stop logic in test_safety_monitor.c

acceptanceCriteria.ac: E-Stop Response Within 1ms - ISR calls sr_emergency_disable_all(), clears enables, engages brakes, tristates outputs
All Brakes Engage on E-Stop - SR_X_BRAKE..SR_B_BRAKE = 0 (active-low) immediately
ESTOP Event Published - EVENT ESTOP ACTIVE via event_manager, system mode = MODE_ESTOP
Motion Commands Rejected in ESTOP Mode - MOVE/MOVR/VEL/HOME return ERROR ERR_EMERGENCY_STOP
RST Clears E-Stop Only If Button Released - check GPIO_E_STOP high before clearing
All Axes Marked UNHOMED on E-Stop - position potentially lost
Hardware Interrupt Configuration - GPIO falling edge, ISR notifies task via xTaskNotifyFromISR

docs.doc: AC16-AC20 definitions, E-Stop Response Flow diagram, NFR12 response time requirement (<1ms)
User story, acceptance criteria, prerequisites (Story 3.1 shift register, Story 2.6 mode management)
Task notification pattern, event publishing pattern, test injection pattern
Core 0 handles safety monitoring at priority 24, Core 1 handles motion control

file.reason: Main file to extend with E-stop ISR and NOTIFY_ESTOP handling
CMD_RST already defined, add ERR_EMERGENCY_STOP, ERR_ESTOP_ACTIVE
Add RST command handler, add ESTOP mode check to motion commands
Motion commands need ESTOP mode check

constraints.constraint: ISR-safe: no mutex, no I2C, no logging in E-stop ISR
Fail-safe: brakes active-low, power loss = engaged
safety_monitor_task runs on Core 0 at priority 24
E-stop GPIO is independent of I2C bus
All values from config headers - no magic numbers

tests.standards: ESP-IDF Unity test framework. Unit tests in component test/ directories. Integration tests in firmware/test/integration/. Hardware timing tests require oscilloscope for <1ms validation. Use safety_monitor_inject_test_state() for testing without physical hardware.

ideas.idea: Test ISR notification triggers ESTOP handling in safety_monitor_task
Test sr_emergency_disable_all() clears all enable bits and engages brakes
Test EVENT ESTOP ACTIVE published with correct format
Test MOVE/MOVR/VEL/HOME commands rejected with ERR_EMERGENCY_STOP in ESTOP mode
Test RST succeeds when GPIO_E_STOP high, fails when low
Test all axes marked UNHOMED after E-stop activation
Test GPIO interrupt configured correctly (falling edge)
Oscilloscope test: GPIO fall to SR latch <1ms
